{{Quote|Jolli, you and the lads set your blasters to slow burn! We're going to fry a pair of penniless star-rovers....|Crimson Jack|<ref name="Star Wars (1977) 11">[[Star Wars (1977) 11|''Star Wars'' (1977) 11]]</ref>}}
'''Slow burn''' was a blaster setting that did excruciating but minimal damage, thus causing pain to a victim as long as possible as a form of torture.

==Behind the scenes==
This may be identical to [[The Burning/Legends|the Burning]].
